curiosities: Its TMS9900 made it the first home computer with a 16-bit processor.
Its Speech Synthesizer used the same speech technology as TI's Speak & Spell.
A price war with Commodore drove its price down to about $50 before TI left the market in 1983.
Its cartridges were sold as Solid State Software.
Parsec was one of its best-known games.
